currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful exterior pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM only;no bespoke survey sources or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observed: Inspected elevated west view: pale single square tower embedded in the west nave gable,steep red main roof,lower polygonal eastern roof and small side additions. Tower has pointed glazed/open stages,clock faces and lower rose mark;green copper apron/bulb,open lantern,tall pointed spike and gold crown. Nave west has two lower flanking lancets and one taller center lancet,buttresses and small stone pinnacles. Adjacent old-city walls/buildings and road are excluded.

Inspected tower close view: pale square belfry with tall pointed tracery openings,small round rose below,square clock fields above,flared green copper apron,rounded ribbed bulb,open narrow lantern,belts and tall tapering spike with selected gold edge ribs/crown. Exact crown insignia,clock numerals and tracery patterns are simplified.
